## Details

<a id="raster_irq_init"></a>
### [`raster_irq_init`](../../../../src/irq/raster_irq_4b20.asm#L6) `$4B20`

*routine*

Sets the IRQ vector $0314 to $4ac0, enables only the raster IRQ at line $8a and disables the CIA 1 interrupts. Waits for line $fe, then sets irq_phase to 0.

- **Called from:** [`cold_start`](../init/cold_start.md#cold_start)
- **Reads:** [`RASTER`](../../memory-map.md#RASTER)
- **Writes:** [`CINV`](../../memory-map.md#CINV), [`IRQMSK`](../../memory-map.md#IRQMSK), [`CIAICR`](../../memory-map.md#CIAICR), [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY), [`RASTER`](../../memory-map.md#RASTER), [`BGCOL0`](../../memory-map.md#BGCOL0), [`irq_phase`](../../memory-map.md#irq_phase), [`VICIRQ`](../../memory-map.md#VICIRQ)
